title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into Network Resolution data. When another user with access to the Domain Name System Search dashboard selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the selecting user's permissions. This occurs because the dashboard encodes data-model field values for drilldown links without properly escaping them as SPL search literals. The vulnerability allows the injecting user to access sensitive data and modify some data accessible to the selecting user.
